anomalies.observed: The MCU VDD pins are each placed on single-pin unconnected nets. NAVC1 VSS pins 18 and 63 are only tied together and are not connected to GND. The +3V3 net, which carries MCU-adjacent decoupling, pull-ups and connectors, has no REG2 output; REG2 OUT is on a separate +3.3V net.
anomalies.expected: The 3.3 V LDO output should feed both MCU VDD rails, and MCU VSS/VSSA pins should connect to GND.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Both MCUs are effectively unpowered and NAVC1 has no ground return, so the board cannot boot or run.

anomalies.observed: The FCC HSE crystal is connected to PE6/PE7 rather than the MCU HSE pins PH0/PH1. PH1 is attached to the VREF+_FCC net and filter resistor, while the actual FCC1 VREF+ and VDDA pins are unconnected. FCC1 NRST and BOOT0 are also not connected to their reset/boot networks. On the NAVC side, HSE2 is present but HSE_IN_NAVC/HSE_OUT_NAVC contain no NAVC1 PH0/PH1 nodes.
anomalies.expected: The 25 MHz HSE crystals must connect to MCU PH0/PH1, VREF+/VDDA must connect to the analog supply/filter network, and NRST/BOOT0 must connect to the reset and boot-select circuitry.
anomalies.impact: The MCUs would have no valid external clock, no reset, and no analog reference, preventing normal startup and ADC operation.

anomalies.observed: The NAVC-side I2C sensor bus nets contain only the sensor ICs, test points and pull-ups; no NAVC1 pin is connected to I2C1_SCL_NAVC or I2C1_SDA_NAVC. GPS UART nets connect U10 to GPS_NAVC1 but not to NAVC1. The FCC-NAVC UART2, I2C2 and GPIO link nets terminate in series resistors with no NAVC1 pin on the NAVC side.
anomalies.expected: NAVC1 must be connected to the IMU, magnetometer, barometer, temperature sensor, EEPROM and GPS, and to the FCC via UART2, I2C and GPIO.

evidence.quote: NAVC — gathers IMU, magnetometer, pressure sensor and GPS receiver data
NAVC↔FCC run UART2 + I2C + GPIO between the two MCUs

anomalies.impact: The navigation MCU cannot communicate with its sensors or the flight-control MCU, so navigation data and inter-processor coordination are unavailable.
